name_original: Nikon - Coolpix AW130 16.0-Megapixel Digital Camera - Blue
description_original: With a NIKKOR 24-120mm wide-angle glass lens and a 16.0-megapixel CMOS sensor, this Nikon Coolpix AW130 digital camera lets you capture sharp photos and high-definition video footage. Built-in Wi-Fi makes it easy to share stored footage across devices. Memory card sold separately.
